thread:
Maya (SRE): 🚨 seeing a spike in 5xx/timeouts across hosted inference gateway (us-west-2 + eu-west-1). Alerts fired at ~08:12 UTC. 502/504 rate up from ~6% to ~22%, p99 latency jumped 180ms -> ~1.5s. Starting war room. Logs attached below.

IncidentBot: [ALERT] hosted-gateway-5xx-surge triggered (08:12 UTC) — see alerts.redwood/incident/1795009999

Priya S (Support): Several customers are opening tickets — two enterprise customers (TritonPay, NovaDocs) hit hard. Tickets #SUP-2241, #SUP-2242. Customers reporting timeouts and retries, some seeing billing anomalies due to retry storms. Escalated to enterprise SLA team. :rotating_light:

Tom H (runtime): I’m seeing multiple upstream model containers restarting with OOMs around 08:05–08:10. Kernel change from yesterday's runtime v2.13.1 rollout increased KV cache prefetch window. Heap pressure + continuous batching is causing eviction thrash.

Maya (SRE): stack excerpt:
```
proxy_1 | 2026-03-15T08:11:59Z upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream
model-xyz | runtime: kv-cache alloc failed: cannot reserve 512MB
model-xyz | fatal: oom_killer invoked
```

Lucas (Oncall): Can we divert traffic to fallback model variants and scale the small-pool? Suggest temporary route config: prefer gpt-4s-fallback for non-SLA customers, keep enterprise on isolated pool.

Tom H (runtime): Agreed. Immediate mitigations I can do: 1) rollback runtime to v2.13.0 in affected regions, 2) disable continuous batching on a subset of nodes, 3) increase host memory headroom for kv-cache. Rolling commands now.

Maya (SRE): Executing rollback in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Also setting per-route circuit breaker: 5rps per key for affected /v1/generate endpoints to stop retry storms.

Maya (SRE): patch command used:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --service=runtime --to=v2.13.0
redwoodctl policy set-circuit --route=/v1/generate --max-rps=5
```

Tom H (runtime): disabling batching on 4 nodes: set ENV `ENABLE_BATCHING=false` and restart. Patching now.

Priya S (Support): Support update: notified top 6 impacted customers, offering 50% usage credit while we investigate. Collecting repro steps — two customers reported spikes caused by client-side aggressive retry (linear backoff missing). Asking for request IDs to triage.

Lucas (Oncall): I bumped the fallback pool to +30% capacity and added temporary route to fallback model. Gateway circuit breaker is in place. Observability: tracing shows fewer 502s from model pool now.

Maya (SRE): Metrics update: error rate falling from 22% -> 4% in 22 minutes. p99 latency trending back toward baseline. Keeping mitigations for another 30–45m to validate.

Tom H (runtime): Confirming model restarts dropped after rollback and disabling batching. Suspect regression introduced in kernel selector: aggressive prefetch combined with long sequences caused KV cache thrash and OOMs. Root cause investigation ticket INF-2345 created.

Priya S (Support): Customer communications posted to status.redwood.ai and sent targeted emails. Support ticket owners: #SUP-2241 (TritonPay) assigned to @Priya S, #SUP-2242 (NovaDocs) assigned to @Tom H for followup on repros.

Maya (SRE): War room status: mitigations applied, traffic stable. Standby for postmortem. If no regressions, will start gradual rollback validation and then mark incident resolved.

Lucas (Oncall): Proposed action items (quick list):
- enforce staging e2e with long-sequence kv/cache pressure test (owner: Lucas, due: 2026-03-20)
- add canary gating for kernel selector changes (owner: Tom H, due: 2026-03-18)
- add circuit-breaker sane defaults to gateway (owner: Maya, due: 2026-03-17)
- customer compensation & comms follow-up (owner: Priya S, due: 2026-03-16)
- RCA doc + postmortem meeting (owner: Maya, meeting scheduled 2026-03-17 17:00 UTC)

Tom H (runtime): Also adding automated regression test for continuous-batching + kv-prefetch combos (ticket INF-2346). Will include memory/alloc telemetry in cadence.

Priya S (Support): Logging final notes for tickets: record of mitigation steps, credits offered, and ask customers to share request_ids where they saw 5xx — helps us map to traces.

IncidentBot: War room: mitigations applied and monitoring passed threshold. Auto-check in 30m.

Maya (SRE): Stand down for war room at 09:05 UTC — leaving followups and owners as above. Creating the postmortem doc now: /docs/incidents/INF-2345-postmortem.

Priya S (Support): Closing note: two customers requested postmortem; schedule for followup call after RCA published. I'll coordinate.

Tom H (runtime): Final: pushing release with kernel selector guard rails and tighter memory caps to canary tomorrow. Will paste change list in the postmortem.

Maya (SRE): Thanks all. Good incident response — quick rollback + routing mitigations prevented larger customer impact.
